purpose: Planned mapping of original approved states to emitted native XCTest attachment names. This is not a capture index or verification result.

validation.signedBuildIdentity: Root must attach the exact candidate/run identity during export; do not reuse historical attachments automatically.

globalRules: Only adopt a candidate after locating the attachment in the intended test run, checking its actual theme, device, visible state and viewport, and inspecting the rendered image.
Filenames use the screenshot attachment name with .png; export tools may add prefixes. Match attachment metadata and originating test method before naming the verified export.
All mapped app fixtures use the design-review memory-only container. Sample people, dishes, counts, photos and forecasts are content differences; they are not live sync evidence.
No phone push, live multi-account avatar/activity, live invitation acceptance or WeatherKit delivery pass is inferred from an in-app screenshot.
Normal-size states cannot be replaced by AX captures or another appearance. Light/dark are explicit distinct entries.
Source approval remains unchanged. Later explicit iPad landscape-only approval applies to orientation; it does not waive two-column spacing, hierarchy or narrow-window behavior.
A null entry is intentional missing exact-state evidence. Related captures may aid diagnosis but must not fill that entry.
This file does not modify capture-index.js, the comparison HTML or native image files.
Supplemental-test mappings are source-only candidates; do not mistake an unexecuted test method for an exported native image.

October 20 adds exact waiting-post, pending-reply and inviter-sent test candidates plus light iPad. All remain unverified for the final current source; ongoing placeholder-identity recovery review/build must complete before adopting results.
